title: Infinite Hallway Painting
description: A large ornate gold-framed painting hangs on a dark gallery wall, depicting an endless narrow hallway with peeling red walls, wooden floor, and multiple doors receding into the distance. The gallery scene includes a wooden desk with a glowing green banker's lamp, a person in a dark suit partially visible on the left, other framed paintings on the walls, and rain-streaked windows revealing a stormy purple night outside.
